purpose: Exercise the 2026-09-18 dependency-identity/fallback rule against existing C04 editable artifacts without rewriting their historical QC or inventing an exact-font/runtime claim.

dependency_records.identity_or_authority_ref: CSS --serif stack: Noto Serif SC → Songti SC → generic serif
dependency_records.resolution_method: browser font resolution from declared CSS stack
dependency_records.rationale: The design claim depends on serif/sans hierarchy and readable CJK typography, not on Noto Serif SC as an exclusive brand-authority font. An explicit fallback may be acceptable, but future final/reproducible render must record which face actually resolved and visually read it back.

dependency_records.identity_or_authority_ref: CSS --sans stack: Noto Sans SC → PingFang SC → Microsoft YaHei → generic sans
dependency_records.resolution_method: browser font resolution from declared CSS stack
dependency_records.rationale: Exact Noto identity is not a locked Current requirement, but resolved font metrics can change hierarchy, wrapping and control density.

dependency_records.identity_or_authority_ref: standards-capable browser runtime supporting dialog/localStorage/print/SVG/DOM interaction
dependency_records.rationale: Source/static checks exist, but the current QC already holds actual live browser readback. The dependency extension preserves rather than upgrades that HOLD.

prospective_delivery_condition: Do not require Noto as exclusive identity unless a future Design/Brand authority explicitly locks it.
For a future final/reproducible browser claim, record actual browser/runtime identity and resolved material font identities or equivalent evidence.
Run actual visual/interaction readback after any declared equivalent fallback.
Until actual browser readback exists, do not upgrade the historical HOLD.

dependency_records.identity_or_authority_ref: SVG font stack: Noto Serif SC → Songti SC → generic serif
dependency_records.resolution_method: SVG renderer font resolution from declared stack
dependency_records.rationale: M01 is an A5 physical prototype whose page hierarchy and live vector text depend on font metrics, but Current does not lock Noto as a unique brand font.

dependency_records.identity_or_authority_ref: SVG font stack: Noto Sans SC → Microsoft YaHei → generic sans
dependency_records.resolution_method: SVG renderer font resolution from declared stack
dependency_records.rationale: Fallback is not prohibited by Current design authority, but a final print/export must read back actual text fit, hierarchy and clipping.

dependency_records.identity_or_authority_ref: SVG renderer capable of live text/CSS/font resolution
dependency_records.resolution_method: render/export environment identity + reopened final artifact
dependency_records.rationale: Native SVG validity is distinct from pixel/print reproducibility. A renderer-equivalent path is allowed only with actual readback.

prospective_delivery_condition: Keep existing M01 concept KEEP / presentation MAIN_CANDIDATE historical result unchanged.
Do not call current SVG parse/vector-text checks exact typography or print reproduction.
Before a future final print/export claim, bind renderer + resolved material font identity and reopen the rendered/exported artifact.
If fallback materially changes wrapping, fit, hierarchy or clipping, repair before delivery rather than normalize the fallback to PASS.

synthesis_findings.finding: A font stack does not automatically require one exact primary font.
synthesis_findings.consequence: Use REQUIRED_FOR_SEMANTIC_FIDELITY + ALLOW_DECLARED_EQUIVALENT when the role/hierarchy is required but the exact family is not Current-locked.

synthesis_findings.finding: Declared fallback names are not the same as observed resolved dependency identity.
synthesis_findings.consequence: A future final/reproducible claim needs actual resolved identity/readback when the dependency materially affects output.

synthesis_findings.finding: The new rule does not retroactively invalidate historical QC.
synthesis_findings.consequence: APP v1.2 remains browser HOLD; M01 remains MAIN_CANDIDATE under its historical review. New dependency evidence is prospective.

synthesis_findings.finding: Static/source validity and rendered/runtime reproducibility remain separate.
synthesis_findings.consequence: SVG/HTML parse PASS cannot substitute for browser/renderer/font-resolution readback.

claim_ceiling: PROSPECTIVE DEPENDENCY-POLICY REAPPLICATION ONLY / NO HISTORICAL QC MUTATION / NO NEW FONT AUTHORITY / NO BROWSER OR PRINT PASS / NO PROMOTION
